text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Kikuka Sho was Kitasan 
Black. Just like her idol Tokai Teio, she 
was showered in thunderous cheers from
the 
entire crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from giving her all in
the 
Kikuka Sho, Cheval Grand opens up about 
what's in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black was similar to herself;
she had never stood out and had harbored 
feelings of inferiority,
yet she faced her 
weaknesses and overcame them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—She wanted to believe that she, too, 
possessed a strength unique to her own 
self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand began looking beyond her 
immediate surroundings.
Setting her sights 
on future showdowns with Kitasan Black, 
she resolved to devote herself to 
training.
